title: Albert Odyssey Gaiden: Legend of Eldean
native_title: アルバート・オデッセイ 外伝 ～レジェンド・オブ・エルディーン～
overview:
Heroes who make a new legend

Several hundred years after the battle of the hero Albert...
In an epic story, a new battle begins
The characters are rendered in animation, and their movements and voices liven up the battle scenes.

Pike lost his family to monsters as a baby and was raised by the winged Harpies. When an evil sorcerer turns his adoptive sister to stone, he sets out to find a cure, carrying Cirrus, a talking sword passed down from his father. On the road he is joined by allies such as the singer Eka, the martial artist Leos and the dragonman Gryzz.

Explore the world map, towns and dungeons from an overhead view, and lead your party through turn-based, menu-driven battles. The adventure unfolds over two parts plus free-quest side scenarios.

- 1 player
- Memory backup

新たな伝説をつくる勇者たち

勇者アルバートの戦いから数百年……。
壮大なストーリーで、新たな戦いが始まる
キャラたちはアニメーションで表現され、動きと声が戦闘シーンを盛り上げる。
